item.title: Hot and Cold: 8 Unforgettable Olympic Figure Skating Romances
item.description: Featuring impassioned Russians, complicated love quadrangles, heartbreaking separations, and the saga of Salé and Pelletier.

item.description: Autumn Durald Arkapaw could be the first woman ever to win a best-cinematography Oscar, though she’s trying not to focus on it: “I feel the pressure of that.”

item.title: Queen Camilla Wore a Brooch That May Symbolize Her Support of King Charles
item.description: The sovereign pinned to her coat a brooch in the shape of a Tudor crown, the very same symbol that Charles III chose to adopt in his personal coat of arms when he became king.

item.description: Complete with Epstein’s musings on Robert Maxwell’s mysterious passing, his curious usage of the word whoops, and an offer for a “fake wife.”

item.description: She saluted her best friend, who shares her boyfriend's birthday, in the same post.

item.description: Last year, Trump became the first president to attend the big game. But going to California—and watching Bad Bunny—is apparently a bridge too far.

item.title: “We’re Wrapping You In Love.” How Savannah Guthrie’s TODAY Colleagues Are Reporting Her Awful News
item.description: NBC colleagues held back tears on-air and shared frequent updates and pleas for help in the investigation into the possible abduction of Nancy Guthrie, Savannah’s 84-year-old mom.

item.title: How New Disney CEO Josh D’Amaro Won Bob Iger’s Heart
item.description: A few years ago, Dana Walden seemed poised to inherit Iger’s seat. Insiders explain why the head of Disney’s parks leapfrogged her in the battle to succeed Iger.
